results: Split/resumed regular-season entries for the same matchup are combined when their total is <=3 games. Games and batting/pitching stats are aggregated into one Results card.
simulation: Remaining games are derived from the live Results API on each load. Completed games/series are not simulated again. Existing simulation-only predetermined results are applied only if still absent from D1.
conditional_forfeit: Migration 0031 deletes the 2026 Goofy Goobers/Twin Titans conditional-forfeit series so the matchup can be played normally.
